name: Science Communication Internship Program (SCIP)
what_you_do: Spend the summer teaching Museum visitors about science. You learn to explain hard ideas in simple ways using the Museum's halls, objects, and hands-on stations.
who_can_apply: New York City high school students in 10th grade who have passed all classes for at least the last 3 terms. You must also have done an AMNH youth program, or a program at a SciNetworkNYC place (such as the Bronx Zoo, New York Botanical Garden, New York Hall of Science, or Wave Hill), or go to a partner school or group on the list. No experience needed.
pay_detail: $2,000 stipend when you finish the program requirements.
duration: Six weeks, July 6 to August 14 in 2026, Monday to Friday, 25 hours a week (10 a.m. to 3 p.m. or noon to 5 p.m.).
deadline_text: The 2026 deadline was March 1, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Apply with the online form linked from the SCIP page when the next round opens.
notes: The page lists the partner schools and groups by name; check it to see if yours is there. You also join career readiness events and Museum events.
